messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired: latency_slo_burn (p95>200ms, p99>600ms) for /v1/generate in eu-west. alert_id=latency_slo_burn_1789999995, pd_incident=PD-9421

alex (oncall): acked. Oncall here, beginning triage. Anyone seeing errors or 5xx?

Jordan: seeing elevated tail on model-serving pool: p95 jumped to ~480ms, p99 ~820ms over last 3m. No spike in 5xx.

Maya: checking sidecars and batcher queues. batcher queue depth up ~3x on nodes eu-west-3, some KV cache evictions logged.

alex (oncall): thanks. Maya, can you post the failing node IDs and a short metric snippet? If we need to divert traffic, I'll flip routing.

Maya: node ids: srv-eu-3a, srv-eu-3b. Metrics: `batcher_queue{node="srv-eu-3a"} 42 -> 128 over 2m`, `kv_cache_evictions_total 341` on both. Likely hotkey or a noisy tenant.

Jordan: checking request distribution — top clients in the window show one customer with 70% of short-chat requests. Could be a bad prompt loop.

Lina (product): pinged Support to verify customer behavior, sending note to their account team. No reported customer-facing errors yet, but latency hit will degrade UX.

alex (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) take srv-eu-3b out of rotation, 2) apply temporary rate-limit for that noisy API key, 3) spin a fallback model variant with lower memory pressure for eu-west. Jordan/Maya can you execute 1 and 2? I'll start 3.

Jordan: taking srv-eu-3b OOS now: `kubectl cordon srv-eu-3b && kubectl drain srv-eu-3b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. Do we want a maintenance override?

Maya: applying key-level throttling now: `rlimit set --key=acct_0x9f --rps=15`. Confirmed throttle rule pushed. Batcher queue depth falling on srv-eu-3a (42 -> 18).

ops-bot: Routed traffic away from srv-eu-3b and applied throttle for acct_0x9f. Autoscaler will add capacity if queue doesn't stabilize.

alex (oncall): good. Jordan, how's p99 looking after actions?

Jordan: p95 back to ~180ms, p99 down to ~300ms within 2 minutes of throttle + drain. Still monitoring for regressions.

Lina (product): support confirmed the account had a runaway job — they paused it after our throttle. No broader customers impacted besides degraded latency for a few sessions.

alex (oncall): marking PD-9421 with a short incident note: cause = noisy tenant causing KV eviction + queueing; mitigation = throttle and cordon; next actions = postmortem + runbook update for autoscale thresholds and hotkey mitigation.

Maya: leaving a TODO in ops runbook: add ephemeral key-level throttling snippet and test. I'll open PR.

Jordan: will monitor for 10 more minutes then handoff to rotation. If p99 stays <=350ms and no 5xx, we'll resolve.

incident-bot: PD-9421 resolved (auto) — all alerts quiet for 8m.

alex (oncall): confirmed quiet. Closing thread in 10. Follow-up: Jordan to post incident summary in incidents channel, Maya to open runbook PR, Lina to coordinate customer RCA email. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Lina (product): drafting customer note now, will share for review.

Jordan: creating a short postmortem doc link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PD-9421 (draft).

alex (oncall): handing over to Jordan for rotation end. I'm available if anything spikes.

Jordan: acked, taking rotation.

alex (oncall): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
